description: This file defines the final class 'PregMatchFlags' which contains static methods to analyze and manipulate PHPStan Types related to preg_match flags, including determining the type of flags argument and removing null from match types.

classes.name: PregMatchFlags
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to determine types of preg_match flags and to manipulate match types within PHPStan static analysis context.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Analyzes the argument for preg_match flags and returns a corresponding PHPStan Type or null if it cannot be determined.

methods.name: removeNullFromMatches
methods.description: Removes null values from a given PHPStan Type representing match results, traversing and transforming the type accordingly.
